name: midir
//desktopName: Linux window association (HTOO-63). Electron uses this as app_id / WM_CLASS; without it a desktop environment cannot link the running window to the installed .desktop entry. It is a package.json field, NOT an electron-builder one. Lowercase, matching win.executableName. Read with linux.syncDesktopName in electron-builder.yml.
description: Companion app for retail Dark Ages — a searchable item index and character record across all of your characters
author: Caeldeth

scripts.validate: npm run lint:check && npm run typecheck && npm test

//allowScripts: npm 12 blocks every dependency install script unless it is listed here, and it blocks SILENTLY on 'npm install' — a warning at the end of the output, exit 0, node_modules populated. electron's postinstall is what downloads the runtime binary into node_modules/electron/dist, so a checkout without this block installs clean and then cannot launch, package, or run e2e. esbuild's postinstall selects its platform binary the same way, and electron-winstaller's picks the 7z build. Nothing else in the tree has an install script; 'npm install-scripts ls' reports anything new.
